title: The friend in the game
summary: Max has played an online game with the same teammate for two years, but he has never seen her face.
paragraphs: Max had a best friend he had never met. Her {{username}} was "NightOwl", and for two years they had played the same online game almost every evening. They talked through headphones while they explored {{virtual}} cities and fought dragons. He knew that she lived in Portugal, that she had two cats and that she hated mushrooms. He didn't know her real name.

His parents were worried. "You don't know who this person really is," his mother said. "People online aren't always honest." Max was annoyed, but a small part of him wondered too. NightOwl's voice sounded young, but he had read stories about adults pretending to be teenagers.

He decided to ask her questions, carefully. Which school did she go to? What was her real name? NightOwl answered some questions and not others. "My parents say I shouldn't give my school's name to people online," she said. "Sorry. It's not personal." Max laughed. "Mine say the same," he said. It was the first time they had talked about being careful, and it made him trust her more, not less.

In the summer, Max's family went on holiday to Lisbon. Max told NightOwl, and she suggested meeting in a public place with their parents. They chose a big café near the river, at four o'clock. Max's mother insisted on coming in with him. His hands were sweating as they walked in.

At a table by the window, a girl of about fifteen was sitting with her father. She had a T-shirt with an owl on it. "Max?" she said. Her real name was Beatriz. The parents shook hands {{awkwardly}} and then started talking about football, while Max and Beatriz talked about the game. It was strange to see her face, but after five minutes it felt completely normal. They still play every evening. And now, when his mother asks, "Who are you talking to?", Max can show her a {{photo}}.

virtual.meaning: made by a computer to look real

awkwardly.meaning: in a way that is uncomfortable or embarrassing

photo.meaning: a picture taken with a camera

username.meaning: the name you use on a website or online game

options: She lived in Portugal, had two cats and hated mushrooms.
